name: mobile-reader
description: Touch-accessible symbol documentation and navigation using the installed language provider.

commands.title: Reader: Toggle compact layout for this window

mobileReader.mode.description: Use the compact reader automatically on narrow touch devices, always, or never. Applies to this browser window without changing desktop editor settings.

mobileReader.maxWidth.description: Maximum screen and viewport width in CSS pixels for automatic compact controls and Markdown reading styles.

mobileReader.readOnlyByDefault.description: Open source code for reading on compact devices. Use Edit or double tap to enable typing.

mobileReader.doubleTapToEdit.description: Double tap source text to enter editing. The Edit button remains available when disabled.

mobileReader.tapToHover.description: A single tap on a word shows the language provider's symbol documentation in reading mode.

mobileReader.hover.highlightOpacity.description: Opacity of the hovered source symbol highlight in compact mode, retaining the current theme's hover color. Increase slightly for a clearer touch target; desktop theme colors stay unchanged.

mobileReader.compactGutter.description: Use a narrow line-number gutter; hide glyph/folding columns and the minimap in the compact reader.

mobileReader.autoHideSidebar.description: Close sidebars after opening or switching a file on compact devices.

mobileReader.dismissPickerOnOutsideTap.description: Cancel Quick Input/file pickers when tapping outside. Trust and confirmation dialogs are not affected.

mobileReader.markdown.enabled.description: Use the configured Markdown typography in compact mode. Desktop preview retains its normal style.

mobileReader.markdown.fontSize.description: Compact Markdown font size in CSS pixels.

mobileReader.markdown.paddingVertical.description: Compact Markdown top/bottom padding in CSS pixels.

mobileReader.markdown.paddingHorizontal.description: Compact Markdown left/right padding in CSS pixels.

mobileReader.gutter.lineNumberCharacters.description: Minimum line-number character width in compact mode. Larger line numbers can still grow.

mobileReader.gutter.decorationWidth.description: Compact decoration column width in CSS pixels.

mobileReader.gutter.glyphMargin.description: Show breakpoint/other glyphs in the compact gutter.

mobileReader.gutter.folding.description: Show code-folding controls in compact mode.

mobileReader.gutter.minimap.description: Show the minimap in compact mode.

mobileReader.gestures.doubleTapInterval.description: Maximum time in milliseconds between taps that enter editing.

mobileReader.gestures.doubleTapDistance.description: Maximum distance in CSS pixels between taps that enter editing.

mobileReader.gestures.moveTolerance.description: Movement above this distance cancels a reading tap. Native Monaco still owns touch scrolling.

mobileReader.gestures.longPressThreshold.description: Presses longer than this many milliseconds are not reading taps.

mobileReader.gestures.hoverDelay.description: Hover delay in milliseconds. Null waits until the double-tap interval ends; zero shows immediately.

mobileReader.gestures.keyboardThreshold.description: Viewport occlusion in CSS pixels used to detect a software keyboard when native keyboard geometry events are unavailable.

mobileReader.toolbar.visibleActions.description: Initial number of visible native editor actions. Swipe horizontally for more.

mobileReader.toolbar.buttonSize.description: Compact editor action width and sidebar button width in CSS pixels.

mobileReader.toolbar.resizable.description: Allow dragging the boundary between tabs and editor actions.

mobileReader.toolbar.maxWidthPercent.description: Maximum percentage of an editor group's width usable by the action strip. At least 96px remains for tabs.

mobileReader.toolbar.order.description: Order of reader actions in the native editor toolbar; omit an action to hide it. Native VS Code actions follow and remain available.
